goal: Allow the GUI to attach to an already running node daemon instead of spawning a new child process
Let users start and stop GUI sessions independently without restarting the underlying node
agreement: Substantive support for the concept and option design (laanwj, meshcollider)
Verified by testing GUI on macOS connecting to Ubuntu node over SSH socket tunnel (Sjors)
Nonblocking bug claim: assertion failure with external signer or PSBTs over IPC, answered (Sjors)
Nonblocking bug claim: node crashes when GUI connects without disablewallet flag, answered (jimhashhq)
